claims.claim: Companies must file a confirmation statement.
claims.quote: Every company, including dormant and non trading companies, must file a confirmation statement at least once every year.
claims.note: The guidance states that every company must file.

claims.claim: Companies must file a confirmation statement at least once every 12 months.
claims.quote: You must review your records and file at least one confirmation statement every 12 months.
claims.note: The guidance states the 12-month frequency for companies.

claims.claim: LLPs must file a confirmation statement.
claims.quote: Every LLP must, before the end of the period of 14 days after the end of each review period, deliver to the registrar
claims.note: The regulation imposes a confirmation statement duty on every LLP.

claims.claim: LLPs must file a confirmation statement at least once every 12 months.
claims.quote: each period of 12 months beginning with the day after the end of the previous review period.
claims.note: The LLP regulation defines successive 12-month review periods for that filing duty.

claims.claim: The annual confirmation statement fee is £50 online.
claims.quote: £50 to file your confirmation statement online
claims.note: The company guidance gives the £50 online fee, but the supplied LLP source does not state an LLP online fee.

claims.claim: The annual confirmation statement fee is £110 by post.
claims.quote: £110 to file a paper form CS01 by post
claims.note: The company guidance gives £110 by post, and the LLP form page also says paper filing costs £110.

claims.claim: A company registered at Companies House must file a confirmation statement.
claims.quote: Every company, including dormant and non trading companies, must file a confirmation statement at least once every year.
claims.note: The Companies House filing guidance imposes the duty on every company.

claims.claim: An LLP registered at Companies House must file a confirmation statement.
claims.quote: Every LLP must, before the end of the period of 14 days after the end of each review period, deliver to the registrar
claims.note: The LLP regulation imposes the filing duty on every LLP.
